changelog:
Initial release of amg-check-storage-account skill for fleet-wide Azure Storage Account health checks:

- On-demand fleet-wide assessment including availability, latency, transactions, and error rates.
- Deep-dives into the 7 most notable storage accounts, analyzing key metrics and resource logs for detailed insights.
- Tracks known issues persistently across sessions via a report file.
- On first run, automatically discovers the Azure Monitor datasource UID and prompts for subscription ID.
- Only runs when explicitly invoked to minimize unnecessary overhead.
